title: A corner breaks Rolle
statement:
For $f(x)=|x-[$a]|$ on $[[$a]-1,[$a]+1]$, find an interior point with $f'(c)=0$, or enter DNE.

[__________]{a}
hints: Their slopes are plus and minus one.
At the join the derivative does not exist.
solution: No interior derivative is zero. The corner violates the differentiability hypothesis.

feedback.message: At the join the derivative does not exist.
